author: Spread
name: Driver
description: A helmet in the team color, the big race number and the name (the label). =VIZ("driver", B2:C2, "L. Hamilton") with B2 = number, C2 = #color.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 320 150"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.hm{fill:var(--color);transition:fill .6s}.big{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-style:italic;font-size:92px;fill:currentColor;letter-spacing:-.04em}.nm{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-style:italic;font-size:24px;fill:currentColor;text-transform:uppercase}</style><defs><linearGradient id="vs" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#0b0c10"/><stop offset=".6" stop-color="#2a2f3a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0b0c10"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="hs" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity=".35"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#fff" stop-opacity="0"/></linearGradient></defs>
<g transform="translate(6 18)"><path class="hm" d="M8 70Q8 8 66 6q48 2 52 52v26q0 18-16 22H30Q8 104 8 70z"/><path d="M8 70Q8 8 66 6q48 2 52 52v26q0 18-16 22H30Q8 104 8 70z" fill="url(#hs)"/><path d="M52 44h64v26q-30 6-64-2z" fill="url(#vs)"/><path d="M20 92h90" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".7" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M14 60q10-40 54-46" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".55" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></g>
<text x="148" y="96" class="big">{{num}}</text><text x="150" y="132" class="nm">{{label}}</text></svg>
